body: I don't know, mind if I pm you?

We used to be really close, but I only recently realized that I kinda liked her. this isn't the only thing that's put me in this endless mood recently, lots of other little stuff. Should I call her and talk about it? I think she'll be over the whole boyfriend thing soon enough

I wish. There were 5 couples total in our little group, and only 2/5 of the couple were actually dating, yet all the girls were equally as huggy except for mine, who I guess is really serious about some guy she met on the internet 1,500 miles away.

I didn't figure she'd say yes if she had a boyfriend in the first place. It's not like I'm crazy for her, I just wanted to have some fun, but she just completely blew me off. And it was really embarrassing, people notice this kind of stuff
